verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits and no shared card numbers (ramp-docs-31). Cards can be restricted to allowed merchants and categories through funds (ramp-docs-41, ramp-supp-spend-controls-agents), and Ramp points to Virtual Cards for subscriptions and recurring merchant charges (ramp-supp-agent-cards, ramp-docs-7, ramp-docs-11). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of merchant-locked card isolation, and explicit documentation that procurement requests issue vendor-specific virtual cards rather than only routing approvals.
